Slithering, searching for prey

Flickering in the night
Silently in the dark
Leaves scrape, suspicious sound
Moving in the night shadow
Leaves rustle, whispering
Dry branches drag the ground as it closes in.
It steps root by root.
Staring at the player
Cold eyes like daggers
Musing in the shadow under the tree roots
Silent with malice
Waiting silently in the dried leaves
Empty eyes, full of intent
Thoughtful in the tree shadow
Watching the player, waiting for an opportunity
Wandering quietly among the tree roots

The eyes beneath its bark are half shut.
Its canopy stirs when there is no wind.
Its growth rings hold many dead things.
It stands still as a dead tree.

lines.zh: 我树皮里的眼睛，盯住斧柄。
lines.en: The eyes in my bark fix on your axe handle.
Cold eyes fix on the player

lines.en: Sees through the darkness to the player
Staring the player down like a torch

It counts the trees you have felled.
Bark eyelids lift slowly.
It peers down at you through its canopy.
A dead branch points at your axe.
It stares at the logs in your hands.
Its eyes reflect the glint of the axe.

lines.zh: 它的树瘤像一张脸转向你。
lines.en: A burl on its trunk turns toward you like a face.

lines.zh: 你在它眼里只是一段木头。
lines.en: To it, you are only another piece of timber.
It stoops, branches hanging before your eyes.
Your Ent is wounded.
The Ent's branches are broken.
The Ent's leaves are torn.
The Ent's roots are trembling.
The Ent's trunk is cracking.
The Ent's bark is peeling.
The Ent's fruit is smashed.
The Ent's roots are pulled out.
The Ent's bark is stripped off.

lines.zh: 树精的年轮又裂开一道。
lines.en: Another crack splits the Ent's growth ring.

lines.zh: 你无法抗拒这棵树的呼唤，树精出现了！
lines.en: You can't resist the call of the tree; the Ent has appeared!

lines.zh: 它的根蔓如蛇般游动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its roots slither like serpents, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着腐烂的树木，它等待着。
lines.en: Chewing on decayed wood, it waits.

lines.zh: 树精的皮肤像树皮一样粗糙，令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: The Ent's skin is as rough as bark, terrifying to touch.

lines.zh: 树精挥舞枝干，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: The Ent swings its branches, seeking a target.

lines.zh: 它渴望着年轻的生命，来延续自己的存在。
lines.en: It craves young life to sustain its own.

lines.zh: 这棵树精是梦魇街上的老住户。
lines.en: This Ent is an old resident of Nightmare Street.

lines.zh: 它会吸取树干中的汁液为生。
lines.en: It feeds on the sap from the trunk.

lines.zh: 树精的叫声就像被风化的树根。
lines.en: The Ent's voice is like the rotted roots.

lines.zh: 它的力量来自古老的树木之灵。
lines.en: Its power comes from ancient tree spirits.

lines.zh: 突然，树精撞向你，枝叶如刀锋。
lines.en: Suddenly, the Ent collides with you, its branches like sharp blades.

lines.zh: 你撞上了树精，仿佛被巨树压倒。
lines.en: You collide with the Ent, as if crushed by a giant tree.

lines.zh: 树精的力量让你无法动弹。
lines.en: The Ent's strength immobilizes you.

lines.zh: 你与树精碰撞，感觉像是被树根缠绕。
lines.en: You collide with the Ent, feeling roots wrapping around you.

lines.zh: 树精的撞击如雷击般强烈。
lines.en: The Ent's collision is as jarring as a lightning strike.

lines.zh: 树精的撞击带走了你的呼吸。
lines.en: The Ent's collision takes your breath away.

lines.zh: 你与树精碰撞，仿佛被闪电击中。
lines.en: You collide with the Ent, as if struck by lightning.

lines.zh: 树精用它的力量压倒你。
lines.en: The Ent overpowers you with its strength.

lines.zh: 你被树精撞飞，撞入黑暗中。
lines.en: You are knocked into the darkness by the Ent.

lines.zh: 树精的力量让你难以抵挡。
lines.en: The Ent's power is overwhelming.

lines.zh: 树精寻找着它的伴侣，以延续生命。
lines.en: The Ent searches for a mate to延续生命.

lines.zh: 它在树间穿梭，寻找它的另一半。
lines.en: It weaves between trees, searching for its half.

lines.zh: 树精的求偶声回荡在森林中。
lines.en: The Ent's mating call echoes through the forest.

lines.zh: 树精的求偶之舞令树木颤抖。
lines.en: The Ent's mating dance causes the trees to tremble.

lines.zh: 它渴望与一棵树结合，成为一体。
lines.en: It longs to merge with a tree, becoming one.

lines.zh: 树精的求偶仪式古老而神秘。
lines.en: The Ent's mating ritual is ancient and mysterious.

lines.zh: 它在树间跳跃，寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: It jumps between trees, searching for a partner.

lines.zh: 树精用它的触角寻找合适的树。
lines.en: The Ent uses its tendrils to find a suitable tree.

lines.zh: 它以古老的仪式召唤它的伴侣。
lines.en: It calls its mate with ancient rituals.

lines.zh: 树精的求偶行为令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: The Ent's mating behavior is terrifying.

lines.zh: 听到你的恐惧，树皮咯吱作响。
lines.en: The bark crackles with your fear.

lines.zh: 啃咬木头，享受痛苦的声音。
lines.en: Chew on the wood, enjoy the sound of pain.

lines.zh: 从黑暗中剥下一层树皮。
lines.en: Peel a layer of bark from the dark.

lines.zh: 树枝轻摇，仿佛在嘲笑你。
lines.en: Branches sway, mocking you.
Rotted wood, gnaw on them.
My secrets hide in the hollows.

lines.zh: 你越是恐惧，我就越强壮。
lines.en: The more you fear, the stronger I grow.
Nightmare roots entangle you.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中生长，汲取你的恐惧。
lines.en: Grow in the darkness, feeding on your fear.
It picks up the wood shavings you dropped.

lines.zh: 你闻到了恐惧的味道吗？
lines.en: Can you smell the fear?
You're my dinner.

lines.zh: 森林中回荡我的脚步声。
lines.en: My footsteps echo in the forest.
I laugh at you.
Your voice calls to me.

lines.zh: 你颤抖的越多，我越强壮。
lines.en: The more you tremble, the stronger I grow.
Your heart beats faster.
Fear leaves you exposed.

lines.zh: 你就是我的下一个目标。
lines.en: You're my next target.
Have you lost your way in dreams?

lines.zh: 你斧头的声响暴露了你。
lines.en: The sound of your axe gave you away.
The fallen tree is proof of your guilt.
It followed its growth rings to you.

lines.zh: 你身上的木屑出卖了你。
lines.en: The sawdust on you betrays you.
No one is innocent in the nightmare woods.

lines.zh: 它的根听到了你的脚步。
lines.en: Its roots heard your footsteps.
My roots are lifting out of the soil.
Fill your heart with fear.

lines.zh: 让恐惧成为你的一部分。
lines.en: Let fear be a part of you.
You cannot escape.
Fear lights the way.
You cannot avoid me.
Fear guides me to you.
You will be devoured by fear.
You are surrounded by fear.
Fear leads you to me.

lines.zh: 它的根须钻进土里锁住你。
lines.en: Its roots burrow in to lock you down.
Dead branches slowly close a circle.
Its canopy darkens and hides the moon.

lines.zh: 它在数你的骨头有几节。
lines.en: It counts the bones in your body.
Its bark splits, baring spikes.

lines.zh: 它抬起最粗的那根枝干。
lines.en: It raises its thickest branch.
The fallen leaves beneath you begin to stir.

lines.zh: 它的影子压住了你的影子。
lines.en: Its shadow falls over yours.
Swing long branches and roar!

lines.zh: 腐朽的树根缠绕，你动弹不得！
lines.en: Decaying roots entangle you!
Attack with withered leaves and twigs!

lines.zh: 发出阴森的嚎叫，吓你一跳！
lines.en: Let out a spooky howl!
Bite with sharp teeth!
Catch your feet with vines!

lines.zh: 缠绕你的身躯，慢慢吞噬！
lines.en: Wrap around you and slowly devour!

lines.zh: 啃食你的灵魂，留下空壳！
lines.en: Feed on your soul, leaving a hollow shell!

lines.zh: 你触碰到我，即意味着死亡！
lines.en: You touch me, and you die!
Wield withered branches in search!

lines.zh: 这一斧，是替那棵树还的！
lines.en: This blow is for the tree you cut!
Taste the splinters of nightmare!

lines.zh: 你倒下的地方会长出我！
lines.en: Where you fall, I will grow!
Your blood will seep into my rings!
Woodcutters pay a price!

lines.zh: 让你也尝尝被劈开的滋味！
lines.en: Now feel what it is to be split!

lines.zh: 梦境中的树木被砍倒，我会来！
lines.en: When a tree falls in the nightmare, I come!

lines.zh: 寂静的夜晚，我从黑暗中走出！
lines.en: I emerge from the dark in the silent night!

lines.zh: 梦魇世界中，我四处巡逻！
lines.en: I patrol the nightmare world!
Hear me in the wind!
I appear in the dark!

lines.zh: 你破坏了我的家园，现在受罚！
lines.en: You've damaged my home, now pay the price!

lines.zh: 树干下有我的巢穴，小心点！
lines.en: My nest is in the tree trunk, beware!
I follow in the night!
Every tree could have me!
I hunt at night!
Your axe falls, and I wake.

lines.zh: 你伐的那棵树是我的兄弟。
lines.en: The tree you felled was my kin.
The nightmare woods are keeping count.

lines.zh: 每一声砍伐都算一次召唤。
lines.en: Every chop is a summons.
I crawled out of the stump.
No felling is allowed in this grove.
Your sawdust fell, and I took root.

lines.zh: 夜深了，梦魇街的树醒了。
lines.en: Deep in the night, the trees of nightmare street wake.
Fire burns the Ent's bark.
The Ent falls from a tree.
The Ent is washed away by water.
The Ent is affected by the explosion.
The Ent is hit by an arrow.
A spell hurt the Ent.
The Ent is starving.
Lightning strikes the Ent.
The Ent falls into the Void.
